SELECT dataset_samples.id 
FROM dataset_samples LEFT OUTER JOIN predictions ON predictions.submission_dataset_id = ? AND predictions.sample_id = dataset_samples.sample_id LEFT OUTER JOIN evaluation_items ON evaluation_items.evaluator_job_id = ? AND evaluation_items.prediction_id = predictions.id LEFT OUTER JOIN score_results ON evaluation_items.score_result_id = score_results.id 
WHERE dataset_samples.dataset_version_id = ? ORDER BY CASE WHEN coalesce(evaluation_items.status = ? AND score_results.id IS NOT NULL AND score_results.evaluator_type = ? AND score_results.score_min = ? AND score_results.score_max = ? AND score_results.unit = ? AND score_results.score BETWEEN ? AND ?, ?) THEN score_results.score END IS NULL, CASE WHEN coalesce(evaluation_items.status = ? AND score_results.id IS NOT NULL AND score_results.evaluator_type = ? AND score_results.score_min = ? AND score_results.score_max = ? AND score_results.unit = ? AND score_results.score BETWEEN ? AND ?, ?) THEN score_results.score END ASC, dataset_samples.id ASC
 LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
